title: Blood Testing, Eye Check-Up & POCSO
summary: Rotary Club Of Mumbai North Island, In Collaboration With Rotary Club Of Mumbai Juhu & The School Bus Owners Association, Organised A Free Blood & Eye Testing Camp Along With POCSO…
description:
Rotary Club Of Mumbai North Island, In Collaboration With Rotary Club Of Mumbai Juhu & The School Bus Owners Association, Organised A Free Blood & Eye Testing Camp Along With POCSO Act, 2012 Awareness Training On 17th October 2026 At Children Welfare Centre School, Versova, Mumbai.

The Medical Camp Provided Health Check-Ups To 255 Individuals, With 167 Pairs Of Spectacles Donated To Beneficiaries Requiring Vision Correction. Additionally, Over 100 School Bus Drivers & Lady Attendants Received POCSO Training To Promote Child Protection, Safety & Awareness Of Their Responsibilities Towards Children.

The Initiative Promoted Community Healthcare While Strengthening Child Safety & Protection.
